title: Implementing a Multi-Step Process for AI Recommendations in Business Central
summary: This post demonstrates how to build a multi-step AI-assisted process in Business Central that generates product recommendations from sales order line descriptions. The process uses AI to identify keywords from sales line data, then searches the item catalog to recommend relevant products for users to add to their orders.
key_points: AI can play a supporting role in a multi-step process rather than providing complete answers
The implementation collects sales line descriptions and passes them to an AI agent to extract keywords
Keywords are used with Full Text Search (release 25.2) to find matching items in the catalog
Users can select recommended items which are then automatically added as new sales lines
Tracking token count by character length helps manage AI costs and improves result quality

quotes.text: The AI Agent doesn't have to provide the entire answer. In this case it digested data that we could use in our process.
quotes.why_it_matters: This insight explains that AI should be designed as part of a workflow, not as a standalone solution, enabling better integration with existing business processes.

quotes.text: On line 18 we use the Full Text Search functions of Business Central that were introduced in release 25.2.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the use of Business Central's native Full Text Search capability to find items matching AI-generated keywords, avoiding the need to share entire catalogs with third parties.
